website.readmeExcerpt:
# AnimationLog

A tiny Dalamud plugin for FFXIV that shows the animation your character is currently playing, and keeps a running log of recent ones for as long as the window is open.

If you have [Penumbra](https://github.com/xivdev/Penumbra) installed, AnimationLog will also tell you when the animation you're seeing has been replaced by a mod, and which one — click the mod's name to jump straight to it in Penumbra.

![AnimationLog window](Screenshots/MainWindow.png)

## Features

- Shows the currently playing base animation, with its internal timeline ID and playback speed
- Keeps a scrollback log of recent animations for the current viewing session
- Detects when Penumbra has redirected an animation to a mod, and shows the mod's name
- Click a mod's name to open it directly in Penumbra

Mod detection covers emotes (matched by Penumbra's own "Emote: X" classification) and other base animations that redirect their timeline script. Mods that only swap out a VFX file Penumbra can't classify on its own (shown in Penumbra as an unnamed "N Files Manipulating Vfxs" entry) - some teleport/cast effect replacers work this way - generally won't be picked up.

## Requirements

- [Dalamud](https://github.com/goatcorp/Dalamud) (via XIVLauncher)
- [Penumbra](https://github.com/xivdev/Penumbra) — optional, only needed for mod-name detection

## Installation

AnimationLog is distributed through [Aetherfit](https://github.com/Kussie/Aetherfit)'s plugin repository.

Open the Dalamud Settings menu in game and follow the steps below. This can be done through the button at the bottom of the plugin installer or by typing `/xlsettings` in the chat.

1. Go to the **"Experimental"** tab.
2. Under Custom Plugin Repositories, enter the repository URL into the empty box at the bottom:
   ```
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kussie/Aetherfit/master/repo.json
   ```
3. Click the **"+"** button.
4. Click the **"Save and Close"** button.

Once added, find AnimationLog in the main `/xlplugins` window and install it.

## Usage

`/animlog` — toggles the Animation Log window.

## AI Usage Disclosure

This project was created with the assistance of AI tools. AI was used to help prototype ideas and refine certain areas, but the final work was reviewed, edited, and completed by me. It was not entirely written or generated by AI.
